sources.title: Redox OS, the operating system written in Rust, bans AI-generated code
sources.snippet: Full stop. AI code? Get out. Redox OS doesn't want any code written by ChatGPT, Copilot, or any other language model. The rule is spelled out in the project's contribution guidelines: any submission identified as LLM-generated (issues, merge requests, descriptions) will be immediately closed.
